body:
A few months ago a friend picked me up to sell me some 2C-E, 2 doses for $20 in one cap. We pulled up to my job to get my paycheck and my boss told me I was fired flat out, payed me off, and I was on my way. It was Friday the 13th.
I dosed the whole cap on the way back to my house, to which he had to say 'you should probably stay home, lots of trees and stuff there on account of living in WA.
On the come up, the world felt really raw. There was this sensation in my heart, like when you eat really greasy food and you feel it in your esophagus, but it was more chemically. I went to the phone and called my boss, feeling incredibly empathetic, and talked him into giving me my job back, so I was feeling pretty good. I did some yard work but by the time I got to the mower I was too high to give a ^Fuck, and nature was looking oddly ugly, like each piece was just a clone of everything else in a different formation. I head inside with the job half done and watch some tv, which was really trippy... I honestly couldn't even follow what was going on at this point. I looked at my ceiling and saw the first real hallucination. There were kaleidoscoping interconnected rainbows breathing across my ceiling, and only my ceiling. Some time after that (gets fuzzy) I decide to tell my parents Im dosed on '2C-e' (whatever that is right) and that I found the key to 'eternal fuckin happiness' to which they told me to go back to my room.
Now I was fully unconscious, viewing myself as doing the eternal cosmic dance of shiva and connecting myself to the entire world, like a puppet master whose strings are energy waves, and I felt nothing but awe and good vibes. The world got more real after that, it was like I created my own reality as I went along that reached deeper and deeper into my ego to create a perfect world in my eyes. It was clear, very lucid real hallucinations to the point that I thought I was actuality altering space and time. Oh and somehow I got the conclusion that everybody is fucking 24/7 with their vibes. Hah.
Somewhere around this time the cops showed up, I thought it was the government trying to figure out how I reached this enlightened state so they could share it with the world. I said '2C-E and Kundalini brothers' (kundalini, in Hinduism, is the release of sexual energy throught your entire body, stimulating you towards change), my kundalini awakening happening 2 months prior with the vision of a blue angel infusing me with energy.
I don't remember much besides that, but the cop car looked like an xbox and I thought the world was remodeling itself in my image to reach world peace.
Then as the world got more intense with all of my likes, I broke through to a psychedelic garden under a tree with a purple sky and gold-violet clouds.
I met with aliens and pharos, who told me I was Jesus and that I had saved the world. I broke out of the trip and now the world got ugly, modeled after my own insecurities, people looked ugly, and the worse I felt and tried to meditate and let go, I felt like the universe was dying. So I put myself back in reality and expressed unconditional love and shit looked better. Then I realized I was in a red hospital room with ivs all in me. I pulled out the water sack (fluoride is creepy) somehow even though I was tied down, arms and legs, on a hospital bed. The nurse came in and looked like a kinky ass demon, asked me about my moms bipolar and a bunch of other personal shit... I was convinced I was in hell. I pelt came down while they kept me tied down for like 5 hours. It was really creepy, but it made me stronger, that's for sure.
Take care with this substance, it's extremely powerful.
